en.stem: A doctor reports that they are unable to access the hospital management system from their home computer. What should you do to resolve this issue?
options: Verify the doctor's remote access privileges
Instruct the doctor to contact their insurance provider
Inform the doctor that remote access is not available for security reasons
Provide the doctor with the system administrator's login credentials
en.explanation: Start by checking whether the account is actually entitled to remote access. Sharing an administrator's credentials is never acceptable - it destroys accountability and breaches every access-control policy.

fr.stem: Un médecin signale qu'il ne peut pas accéder au système de gestion de l'hôpital depuis son ordinateur personnel. Que devez-vous faire pour résoudre ce problème ?
options: Vérifier les privilèges d'accès à distance du médecin
Demandez au médecin de contacter son assureur
Informez le médecin que l'accès à distance n'est pas disponible pour des raisons de sécurité
Fournissez au médecin les informations de connexion de l'administrateur système
fr.explanation: Commencez par vérifier si le compte dispose réellement d'un droit d'accès à distance. Partager les identifiants de l'administrateur n'est jamais acceptable.

en.stem: Which of the following is the best way to handle an angry customer?
options: Interrupt them to correct their mistakes
en.explanation: Active, empathetic listening defuses the situation and surfaces the real problem. Interrupting, hanging up, or deflecting all escalate it.

fr.stem: Parmi les propositions suivantes, laquelle est la meilleure façon de gérer un client en colère ?
fr.explanation: L'écoute active et empathique désamorce la situation et fait apparaître le vrai problème.

en.stem: What is the function of a Solid State Drive (SSD)?
en.explanation: An SSD is non-volatile storage. It holds data in flash memory with no moving parts, which is why it is faster and more shock-resistant than a mechanical hard drive.

fr.stem: Quelle est la fonction d'un disque SSD ?
fr.explanation: Un SSD est un stockage non volatil utilisant de la mémoire flash, sans pièces mobiles.

en.stem: The hospital management system is experiencing issues with data encryption and security due to a compromised encryption key. What is the best approach to resolve this issue while ensuring data protection and minimizing downtime?
options: Implement a data encryption mechanism with automatic key rotation
Implement a key management system with secure key storage
Utilize a hardware security module (HSM) for secure key management
en.explanation: A key management system with secure storage addresses the root cause: the key was exposed because it was not properly protected. Automatic rotation and an HSM are components of a good KMS rather than complete answers on their own.

fr.stem: Le système de gestion de l'hôpital rencontre des problèmes de cryptage et de sécurité des données en raison d'une clé de cryptage compromise. Quelle est la meilleure approche pour résoudre ce problème tout en garantissant la protection des données et en minimisant les temps d'arrêt ?
options: Implémenter un mécanisme de cryptage des données avec rotation automatique des clés
Mettre en oeuvre un système de gestion des clés avec stockage sécurisé des clés
Utiliser un module de sécurité matériel (HSM) pour une gestion sécurisée des clés
fr.explanation: Un système de gestion des clés avec stockage sécurisé traite la cause racine : la clé était exposée car mal protégée.

en.stem: What is the primary purpose of Safe Mode in Windows?
en.explanation: Safe Mode boots with a minimal set of drivers and services so a faulty driver or startup program can be isolated and removed.

fr.stem: Quel est l'objectif principal du mode sans échec sous Windows ?
options: Pour supprimer des fichiers en toute sécurité
Pour mettre à jour les pilotes
Pour diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes
fr.explanation: Le mode sans échec démarre avec un minimum de pilotes et de services afin d'isoler un pilote ou un programme défectueux.

en.stem: When a printer is not printing, which of the following should you check first?
en.explanation: Paper, ink and driver are all standard first-line checks in printer troubleshooting, so the combined option is the intended answer.

fr.stem: Lorsqu'une imprimante n'imprime pas, lequel des éléments suivants devez-vous vérifier en premier ?
fr.explanation: Le papier, l'encre et le pilote font tous partie des premières vérifications standard.

en.stem: Which of the following is an example of an operating system?
en.explanation: Windows 10 is an operating system. Word, Photoshop and Chrome are applications that run on top of one.

fr.stem: Lequel des éléments suivants est un exemple de système d'exploitation ?
fr.explanation: Windows 10 est un système d'exploitation. Word, Photoshop et Chrome sont des applications.

en.stem: What should you do if you cannot resolve a customer's issue immediately?
options: Promise a solution without a timeline
Escalate the issue and provide an estimated resolution time
en.explanation: Escalating with a realistic estimate keeps the customer informed and moves the ticket to someone who can close it.

fr.stem: Que devez-vous faire si vous ne pouvez pas résoudre immédiatement le problème d'un client ?
options: Faire remonter le problème et fournir une estimation du temps de résolution
Dis-leur que tu ne peux pas aider
fr.explanation: Faire remonter le problème avec une estimation réaliste tient le client informé.

en.stem: Which of the following is a key aspect of good customer service?
en.explanation: Speed combined with effectiveness is the core measure of support quality.

fr.stem: Parmi les éléments suivants, lequel est un aspect clé d'un bon service client ?
options: Rediriger tous les appels vers la messagerie vocale
fr.explanation: La rapidité combinée à l'efficacité est la mesure principale de la qualité du support.

en.stem: If a user's computer is running very slowly, which of the following could be a potential cause?
en.explanation: CPU saturation, memory pressure and a full disk each cause slowdowns, so all three are potential causes.

fr.stem: Si l'ordinateur d'un utilisateur fonctionne très lentement, lequel des éléments suivants pourrait en être la cause potentielle ?
fr.explanation: La saturation du processeur, le manque de mémoire et un disque plein provoquent chacun des ralentissements.

en.stem: Which of the following is a primary function of the CPU?
en.explanation: The CPU fetches, decodes and executes instructions. Storage, networking and display are handled by other components.

fr.stem: Parmi les éléments suivants, lequel est une fonction principale du processeur ?
fr.explanation: Le processeur récupère, décode et exécute les instructions.

en.stem: Which command is used to list files and directories in Linux?
en.explanation: ls is the standard Linux listing command. dir exists on some systems as a compatibility alias, but ls is the expected answer; list and show are not commands.

fr.stem: Quelle commande est utilisée pour lister les fichiers et répertoires sous Linux ?
fr.explanation: ls est la commande standard sous Linux. list et show n'existent pas.

en.stem: Which Linux command is used to record a user login session in a file?
en.explanation: script starts a session recorder that writes everything typed and displayed to a typescript file. macro is not a Linux command.

fr.stem: Quelle commande Linux est utilisée pour enregistrer une session de connexion utilisateur dans un fichier ?
fr.explanation: script démarre un enregistreur de session qui écrit tout dans un fichier. macro n'est pas une commande Linux.

en.stem: What device is commonly used to connect multiple computers within a LAN?
en.explanation: A switch forwards frames between hosts inside the same local network. A router joins different networks; a modem converts signals for the WAN link.

fr.stem: Quel appareil est couramment utilisé pour connecter plusieurs ordinateurs au sein d'un réseau local ?
fr.explanation: Un commutateur transmet les trames entre hôtes du même réseau local.

en.stem: Which file system is commonly used on Windows operating system?
en.explanation: NTFS is the standard Windows file system. EXT4 belongs to Linux; APFS and HFS+ are Apple file systems.

fr.stem: Quel système de fichiers est couramment utilisé sur le système d'exploitation Windows ?
fr.explanation: NTFS est le système de fichiers standard de Windows.

en.stem: What is the first step in troubleshooting a computer that won't turn on?
options: Check the power supply and connections
en.explanation: Always start with power. A dead outlet, loose cable or failed PSU explains the symptom before anything else is worth testing.

fr.stem: Quelle est la première étape pour dépanner un ordinateur qui ne s'allume pas ?
fr.explanation: Commencez toujours par l'alimentation avant de tester autre chose.

en.stem: Which cable type is most commonly used for Ethernet connections?
en.explanation: Twisted pair (Cat5e/Cat6) is by far the most common Ethernet medium. Fibre is used for long or high-capacity links, not for the typical desk connection.

fr.stem: Quel type de câble est le plus couramment utilisé pour les connexions Ethernet ?
fr.explanation: La paire torsadée (Cat5e/Cat6) est de loin le support Ethernet le plus courant.

en.stem: What is the main function of an operating system?
en.explanation: The operating system manages CPU, memory, storage and devices, and schedules access to them. Running applications is a consequence of that role, not the definition of it.

fr.stem: Quelle est la fonction principale d'un système d'exploitation ?
fr.explanation: Le système d'exploitation gère le processeur, la mémoire, le stockage et les périphériques.

en.stem: Which of the following phrases is most appropriate when dealing with a customer complaint?
options: "I understand your frustration, let me help resolve this."
en.explanation: Acknowledging the feeling and immediately offering help is the standard de-escalation phrasing.

fr.stem: Laquelle des phrases suivantes est la plus appropriée pour traiter une réclamation client ?
options: "Je comprends votre frustration, laissez-moi vous aider à résoudre ce problème."
fr.explanation: Reconnaître l'émotion et proposer immédiatement de l'aide est la formulation standard.

en.stem: A user reports that they are unable to access the hospital management system due to a slow internet connection. What steps would you take to troubleshoot this issue?
options: Instruct the user to contact their internet service provider
Inform the user that the system is experiencing high traffic and recommend accessing it during off-peak hours
Inform the user to Verify the network connectivity and sleep computer
en.explanation: Verify connectivity locally before blaming an external party. Sending the user to their ISP first skips the diagnosis entirely.

fr.stem: Un utilisateur signale qu'il ne parvient pas à accéder au système de gestion de l'hôpital en raison d'une connexion Internet lente. Quelles mesures prendriez-vous pour résoudre ce problème ?
options: Demandez à l'utilisateur de contacter son fournisseur d'accès Internet
Informer l'utilisateur que le système connaît un trafic élevé et lui recommander d'y accéder pendant les heures creuses
Informez l'utilisateur de vérifier la connectivité réseau et l'ordinateur en veille
fr.explanation: Vérifiez la connectivité localement avant d'incriminer un tiers externe.

en.stem: What is the purpose of DNS?
options: To translate domain names to IP addresses
en.explanation: DNS resolves human-readable names to IP addresses. Assigning addresses is DHCP's job - a very common confusion.

fr.stem: Quel est le but du DNS ?
options: Pour stocker les données du site Web
Pour traduire les noms de domaine en adresses IP
fr.explanation: Le DNS résout les noms en adresses IP. L'attribution d'adresses est le rôle du DHCP.

en.stem: What does a 'blue screen of death' (BSOD) typically indicate?
en.explanation: A BSOD is a kernel-level stop error. Hardware failure is one possible cause among many, including bad drivers and corrupt system files, so the general answer is the correct one.

fr.stem: Qu'indique généralement un écran bleu de la mort (BSOD) ?
options: Plantage du système ou erreur fatale
fr.explanation: Un BSOD est une erreur d'arrêt au niveau du noyau, dont la panne matérielle n'est qu'une cause possible.

en.stem: A user reports that they are unable to access the hospital management system due to a certificate expiration issue. What steps would you take to troubleshoot and resolve the issue while ensuring system availability?
options: Utilize a certificate revocation list (CRL) to block access from expired certificates
Promise a solution without a timeline
Renew the expired certificate and update it on the system
en.explanation: Renewing and installing the certificate restores trust and availability. A CRL blocks access rather than restoring it.

fr.stem: Un utilisateur signale qu'il ne peut pas accéder au système de gestion de l'hôpital en raison d'un problème d'expiration de certificat. Quelles mesures prendriez-vous pour dépanner et résoudre le problème tout en garantissant la disponibilité du système ?
options: Utiliser une liste de révocation de certificats (CRL) pour bloquer l'accès aux certificats expirés
Renouveler le certificat expiré et le mettre à jour sur le système
fr.explanation: Renouveler et installer le certificat rétablit la confiance et la disponibilité.

en.stem: What does RAM stand for?
en.explanation: Random Access Memory - volatile working memory in which any location can be reached directly, without reading through what precedes it.

fr.stem: Que signifie RAM ?
fr.explanation: Random Access Memory - mémoire de travail volatile accessible directement à n'importe quelle adresse.

en.stem: What is the best way to end a call with a satisfied customer?
options: Thank them and confirm their issue is resolved
en.explanation: Confirming resolution and thanking the caller closes the loop and prevents repeat contacts.

fr.stem: Quelle est la meilleure façon de terminer un appel avec un client satisfait ?
options: Remerciez-les et confirmez que leur problème est résolu
fr.explanation: Confirmer la résolution et remercier l'appelant boucle l'échange.

en.stem: Which of the following tools is used to diagnose network connectivity issues?
en.explanation: ping sends ICMP echo requests to test reachability and latency. The other three are local maintenance tools with no network diagnostic role.

fr.stem: Lequel des outils suivants est utilisé pour diagnostiquer les problèmes de connectivité réseau ?
fr.explanation: ping envoie des requêtes ICMP pour tester l'accessibilité et la latence.

en.stem: The hospital management system is experiencing issues with user authentication due to a compromised authentication token. What is the best approach to resolve this issue while minimizing disruption to patient care?
options: Utilize a multi-factor authentication system to add an additional layer of security
Implement a token-based authentication system with secure token storage
Implement a token revocation mechanism to invalidate compromised tokens
en.explanation: Combining multi-factor authentication with securely stored tokens both contains the current compromise and hardens against the next one.

fr.stem: Le système de gestion de l'hôpital rencontre des problèmes d'authentification des utilisateurs en raison d'un jeton d'authentification compromis. Quelle est la meilleure approche pour résoudre ce problème tout en minimisant les perturbations dans les soins aux patients ?
options: b) et c) à la fois
Utilisez un système d'authentification multifacteur pour ajouter une couche de sécurité supplémentaire
Implémentez un système d'authentification base sur des jetons avec un stockage sécurisé des jetons
Implémenter un mécanisme de révocation de jetons pour invalider les jetons compromis
fr.explanation: Combiner l'authentification multifacteur et un stockage sécurisé des jetons traite la compromission actuelle et future.

en.stem: What is the main purpose of a firewall?
en.explanation: A firewall inspects and filters traffic against a rule set. Anti-malware is a separate control - a firewall does not scan files for infection.

fr.stem: Quel est l'objectif principal d'un pare-feu ?
options: Pour se protéger contre les logiciels malveillants
fr.explanation: Un pare-feu inspecte et filtre le trafic selon un ensemble de règles.

en.stem: Which of the following is a Linux distribution?
en.explanation: Ubuntu is a Linux distribution. macOS and iOS are Apple's Unix-derived systems but are not Linux; Windows is unrelated.

fr.stem: Lequel des éléments suivants est une distribution Linux ?
fr.explanation: Ubuntu est une distribution Linux. macOS et iOS ne sont pas Linux.

en.stem: What does VPN stand for?
en.explanation: Virtual Private Network - an encrypted tunnel that carries private traffic across a public network.

fr.stem: Que signifie VPN ?
fr.explanation: Réseau privé virtuel - un tunnel chiffré qui transporte du trafic privé sur un réseau public.

en.stem: What type of malware disguises itself as legitimate software?
en.explanation: A Trojan is defined by its disguise - it looks like something the user wants. A virus attaches to files, a worm self-propagates, spyware collects data covertly.

fr.stem: Quel type de malware se fait passer pour un logiciel légitime ?
fr.explanation: Un cheval de Troie se definit par son déguisement. Un virus s'attache aux fichiers, un ver se propage seul.

en.stem: What is a common method for securing user passwords?
en.explanation: Passwords are stored as salted hashes so the original value cannot be recovered from a database breach.

fr.stem: Quelle est une méthode courante pour sécuriser les mots de passe des utilisateurs ?
options: Utiliser le hachage de mot de passe
fr.explanation: Les mots de passe sont stockés sous forme de hachages salés, irréversibles en cas de fuite.

en.stem: A user reports that they are unable to access the hospital management system due to a denial-of-service (DoS) attack. What steps would you take to mitigate the attack and restore system availability?
options: Implement a web application firewall (WAF) to filter malicious traffic
Implement rate-limiting mechanisms to prevent excessive requests
Utilize a content delivery network (CDN) to distribute the system's resources
en.explanation: WAF filtering, rate limiting and CDN distribution are complementary layers of DoS mitigation, normally deployed together rather than chosen between.

fr.stem: Un utilisateur signale qu'il ne peut pas accéder au système de gestion de l'hôpital en raison d'une attaque par déni de service (DoS). Quelles mesures prendriez-vous pour atténuer l'attaque et restaurer la disponibilité du système ?
options: Implémentez un pare-feu d'application Web (WAF) pour filtrer le trafic malveillant
Mettre en oeuvre des mécanismes de limitation de débit pour éviter les demandes excessives
Utiliser un réseau de diffusion de contenu (CDN) pour distribuer les ressources du système
fr.explanation: Le filtrage WAF, la limitation de débit et le CDN sont des couches complémentaires.

en.stem: What should you do before upgrading the operating system on a user's computer?
en.explanation: A verified backup is the mandatory first step - an upgrade can fail and leave data unrecoverable.

fr.stem: Que devez-vous faire avant de mettre à niveau le système d'exploitation sur l'ordinateur d'un utilisateur ?
fr.explanation: Une sauvegarde vérifiée est l'étape obligatoire avant toute mise à niveau.

en.stem: What is the purpose of a UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply)?
en.explanation: A UPS supplies battery power during an outage so equipment can ride through it or shut down cleanly.

fr.stem: A quoi sert un UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) ?
options: Pour fournir une alimentation de secours
Pour augmenter la vitesse de traitement
Pour se protéger contre les virus
fr.explanation: Un onduleur fournit une alimentation sur batterie pendant une coupure.

en.stem: What is the main purpose of antivirus software?
en.explanation: Antivirus software identifies malicious code by signature and behaviour, then quarantines or removes it.

fr.stem: Quel est l'objectif principal d'un logiciel antivirus ?
options: Pour détecter et supprimer les logiciels malveillants
fr.explanation: L'antivirus identifie le code malveillant puis le met en quarantaine ou le supprime.

en.stem: Which of the following is an example of two-factor authentication?
en.explanation: Two factors must come from different categories: something you know plus something you are. A password paired with a username, CAPTCHA or security question is still only one category.

fr.stem: Lequel des éléments suivants est un exemple d'authentification à deux facteurs ?
options: Mot de passe et nom d'utilisateur
Mot de passe et empreinte digitale
Mot de passe et question de sécurité
fr.explanation: Les deux facteurs doivent provenir de catégories différentes : ce que vous savez et ce que vous êtes.

en.stem: When setting up a new user account, what is an important first step?
en.explanation: A strong password comes first. Handing out administrative rights by default violates least privilege and is the opposite of good practice.

fr.stem: Lors de la création d'un nouveau compte utilisateur, quelle est la première étape importante ?
options: Installation de tous les logiciels disponibles
Créer un mot de passe fort
fr.explanation: Un mot de passe fort vient en premier. Accorder des droits d'administration par défaut viole le moindre privilège.

en.stem: Which command would you use to restart a Windows computer from the Command Prompt?
en.explanation: shutdown /r restarts Windows. reboot and restart are not Windows commands, and exit only closes the prompt.

fr.stem: Quelle commande utiliseriez-vous pour redémarrer un ordinateur Windows à partir de l'invite de commande ?
fr.explanation: shutdown /r redémarre Windows. reboot et restart ne sont pas des commandes Windows.

en.stem: Which of the following is considered a strong password?
en.explanation: Of the four, only P@ssw0rd! mixes character classes. In real use it is still weak, because it is a dictionary word with predictable substitutions - length and unpredictability matter more than symbol count.

fr.stem: Lequel des éléments suivants est considéré comme un mot de passe fort ?
fr.explanation: Seul P@ssw0rd! mélange les classes de caractères, même s'il reste faible en pratique.

en.stem: Which tool would you use to check for disk errors in Windows?
en.explanation: chkdsk scans the file system and disk surface for errors. Disk Management partitions drives; Disk Cleanup only frees space.

fr.stem: Quel outil utiliseriez-vous pour vérifier les erreurs de disque sous Windows ?
fr.explanation: chkdsk analyse le système de fichiers et la surface du disque à la recherche d'erreurs.

en.stem: What is the primary function of a router?
options: To connect computers to the internet
en.explanation: A router forwards packets between networks, which is what links a local network to the internet.

fr.stem: Quelle est la fonction principale d'un routeur ?
options: Pour connecter les ordinateurs à Internet
fr.explanation: Un routeur achemine les paquets entre réseaux, reliant le réseau local à Internet.

en.stem: What is the primary benefit of using cloud storage services?
en.explanation: Cloud storage makes files reachable from any location and device. It does not change local processing or graphics performance.

fr.stem: Quel est le principal avantage de l'utilisation des services de stockage cloud ?
options: Capacité de stockage locale plus élevée
fr.explanation: Le stockage cloud rend les fichiers accessibles depuis n'importe quel endroit et appareil.

en.stem: What protocol is used to send email?
en.explanation: SMTP sends mail. POP3 and IMAP retrieve it; HTTP serves web content.

fr.stem: Quel protocole est utilisé pour envoyer des e-mails ?
fr.explanation: SMTP envoie le courrier. POP3 et IMAP servent à le récupérer.

en.stem: A user reports that they are unable to access the hospital management system due to a firewall blocking the connection. What should you do to resolve this issue?
options: Contact the system administrator for assistance
Inform the user that the system is down for maintenance
Configure the firewall to allow the system connection
Instruct the user to contact their internet service provider
en.explanation: Add the required rule so legitimate traffic is permitted. The other options either misinform the user or push the problem elsewhere.

fr.stem: Un utilisateur signale qu'il ne peut pas accéder au système de gestion de l'hôpital en raison d'un pare-feu bloquant la connexion. Que devez-vous faire pour résoudre ce problème ?
options: Contactez l'administrateur système pour obtenir de l'aide
Informer l'utilisateur que le système est en panne pour maintenance
Configurer le pare-feu pour autoriser la connexion au système
Demandez à l'utilisateur de contacter son fournisseur d'accès Internet
fr.explanation: Ajoutez la règle nécessaire pour autoriser le trafic légitime.

en.stem: Which of the following is the most important when dealing with a frustrated customer?
options: Using technical jargon to assert authority
Speaking quickly to resolve the issue faster
Maintaining a calm and empathetic demeanor
en.explanation: Staying calm and empathetic is what actually de-escalates. Speaking quickly tends to make a frustrated caller feel dismissed.

fr.stem: Parmi les éléments suivants, lequel est le plus important lorsque vous traitez avec un client frustré ?
options: Utiliser le jargon technique pour affirmer l'autorité
Parler vite pour résoudre le problème plus rapidement
Les rediriger vers des ressources en ligne
Garder une attitude calme et empathique
fr.explanation: Rester calme et empathique désamorce réellement la situation.

en.stem: What is a common reason for emails being marked as spam?
options: Use of common phrases and links associated with spam
en.explanation: Spam filters score message content against known spam patterns - trigger phrases and suspicious links. Recipient count alone does not mark a message as spam.

fr.stem: Quelle est la raison courante pour laquelle les e-e-mails sont marqués comme spam ?
options: Utilisation d'expressions courantes et de liens associés au spam
fr.explanation: Les filtres analysent le contenu par rapport à des motifs de spam connus.

en.stem: Which of the following is an example of a phishing attack?
options: An email that asks for personal information by pretending to be from a legitimate source
en.explanation: Phishing is social engineering by impersonation - a message that pretends to be a trusted sender in order to extract credentials or personal data.

fr.stem: Lequel des éléments suivants est un exemple d'attaque de phishing ?
options: Un message d'erreur généré par le système
Un e-mail qui demande des informations personnelles en prétendant provenir d'une source légitime
Une confirmation d'inscription à la newsletter
Une notification de mise à jour du logiciel
fr.explanation: Le phishing est une usurpation d'identité visant à extraire des identifiants ou des données personnelles.

en.stem: A user reports that their computer screen is flickering. What should be your first step in troubleshooting this issue?
en.explanation: Update the driver first: it is free, reversible and a very common cause. Replacing hardware or reinstalling the OS are far more disruptive and belong later in the sequence.

fr.stem: Un utilisateur signale que l'écran de son ordinateur scintille. Quelle devrait être votre première étape pour résoudre ce problème ?
options: Mettre à jour le pilote graphique
fr.explanation: Mettez d'abord à jour le pilote : c'est gratuit, réversible et une cause très fréquente.

en.stem: What does SaaS stand for in cloud computing?
en.explanation: Software as a Service - applications delivered over the network, with the provider managing the underlying infrastructure entirely.

fr.stem: Que signifie SaaS dans le cloud computing ?
fr.explanation: Logiciel en tant que service - des applications livrées via le réseau, l'infrastructure étant gérée par le fournisseur.

en.stem: A junior technician notices collisions on an interface connected to a legacy hub. Which duplex setting is most likely causing this issue?
en.explanation: Hubs operate in half-duplex, which is a shared collision domain. Full-duplex allows simultaneous transmission and reception without collisions.

en.stem: After replacing a PC, the switchport logs show a continuous flapping of MAC addresses. What is the most probable reason for this behavior?
options: A Layer 2 loop due to disabled spanning tree
A faulty NIC on the PC
en.explanation: MAC address flapping is a classic symptom of a Layer 2 loop, where broadcast frames circle endlessly and cause the switch to continually update its MAC address table with different ports for the same MAC.

en.stem: An engineer analyzes a packet capture and observes ARP replies arriving without corresponding ARP requests. This behavior is indicative of what process or attack?
en.explanation: Gratuitous ARPs are sent without requests to update neighbor caches (e.g., for HA failover), but they can also be used maliciously for ARP spoofing (poisoning).

en.stem: Users complain of slow performance. An interface shows late collisions and CRC errors. What is the standard troubleshooting step for this symptom?
options: Verify duplex settings on both ends of the link
en.explanation: Late collisions and CRC errors often indicate a duplex mismatch (e.g., one side full-duplex, the other side half-duplex).

en.stem: A router needs to forward a packet but its ARP cache is empty for the destination IP on a directly connected subnet. What does the router do next?
options: Broadcasts an ARP request for the destination IP MAC address
Sends the packet to the default gateway
en.explanation: Before encapsulating a packet into a frame for a local subnet, a device must know the destination MAC address. It uses an ARP request to find it.

en.stem: A router has three routes to 10.1.1.0/24: an OSPF route, an EIGRP route, and a Static route. Which route will be installed in the routing table?
en.explanation: Administrative Distance determines route preference. Static=1, EIGRP=90, OSPF=110. The static route has the lowest AD and is preferred.

en.stem: A packet is destined for 192.168.1.130. The routing table has 192.168.1.0/24 (AD 110) and 192.168.1.128/26 (AD 120). Which path does the router choose?
en.explanation: The router uses the longest prefix match rule first, regardless of administrative distance. The /26 is more specific.

en.stem: A technician configures a floating static route as a backup to an EIGRP learned route for branch office connectivity. What is the necessary configuration step?
options: Set the static route AD to a value higher than 90
Set the static route AD to a value lower than 90
en.explanation: A floating static route acts as a backup. EIGRP has an AD of 90. To make the static route less preferred, its AD must be configured higher than 90.

en.stem: Looking at the `show ip route` output, you see a route marked with a "D". What routing protocol generated this entry?
en.explanation: In the Cisco routing table, "D" stands for DUAL, the algorithm used by EIGRP.

en.stem: You need to route traffic to the internet but do not have a specific route in the routing table. What kind of route should be configured?
en.explanation: A default route (0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0) acts as the gateway of last resort when no specific route matches the destination.

en.stem: An admin notices a routing loop forming between three routers running RIPv2. Which mechanism prevents routing loops by not advertising a route back on the interface it was learned from?
en.explanation: Split horizon is a distance vector loop prevention mechanism that dictates a route cannot be advertised back out the interface it was learned on.

en.stem: A multi-access OSPF network needs to elect a DR and BDR. Which router attribute is evaluated first to determine the DR?
en.explanation: OSPF DR election first looks at interface Priority (default is 1). If there is a tie, it breaks the tie using the highest Router ID.

en.stem: Two OSPF routers are connected over a point-to-point link. One router is stuck in the EXSTART state. What is the most likely cause of this issue?
en.explanation: EXSTART is where the routers establish master/slave relation and MTU. If the MTU sizes do not match, the routers will be stuck in EXSTART/EXCHANGE.

en.stem: A network architect is designing a multi-area OSPF network. What is the strict requirement regarding Area 0?
options: All other areas must connect directly to Area 0
en.explanation: In OSPF, Area 0 is the backbone. All non-backbone areas must physically (or logically via virtual link) connect directly to Area 0 to prevent routing loops.

en.stem: A technician is analyzing OSPF LSAs. Which LSA type is used by an ABR to advertise routes between different areas?
en.explanation: Type 3 Summary LSAs are generated by Area Border Routers (ABRs) to flood inter-area routing information into other areas.

en.stem: A user submits a ticket stating their screen is completely black, but the computer fan is spinning. What is the FIRST troubleshooting step?
options: Check the monitor power and display cable connections
en.explanation: Always start troubleshooting at the physical layer (Layer 1). Checking power cables and display connections is the simplest and most common fix.

en.stem: A help desk technician receives a "Blue Screen of Death" (BSOD) error indicating "PAGE_FAULT_IN_NONPAGED_AREA". What is the most likely hardware culprit?
en.explanation: This specific BSOD usually points to faulty RAM, incorrect memory timings, or sometimes a bad driver trying to access invalid memory addresses.

en.stem: An employee reports that a local network printer is printing garbled text instead of the actual document. What is the most probable cause?
options: An incorrect or corrupted printer driver
The printer is out of toner
The print spooler service has stopped
The network switch is dropping packets
en.explanation: Garbled or "gibberish" printouts occur when the printer receives data it cannot understand, almost always due to an incorrect or corrupted driver.

en.stem: A user’s laptop connects to the Wi-Fi but shows "No Internet Access". The IP address assigned is 169.254.x.x. What does this indicate?
options: The DHCP server is unreachable and APIPA assigned the IP
The user typed the wrong Wi-Fi password
The router is blocking the MAC address
en.explanation: A 169.254.x.x address is an Automatic Private IP Address (APIPA), assigned by the OS when it cannot reach a DHCP server.

en.stem: A tier-1 agent cannot resolve a complex database connectivity issue after 30 minutes of troubleshooting. What is the proper ITIL procedure?
options: Escalate the ticket to Tier 2 or the database team
Close the ticket and ask the user to reboot
Tell the user the system is broken
en.explanation: Escalation paths ensure that complex issues are handed off to specialized teams within the SLA timeframes.

en.stem: A user complains of application crashes immediately after installing a new Windows update. What is the fastest way to restore functionality?
options: Uninstall the recent Windows update or use System Restore
Upgrade the application to a beta version
en.explanation: Rolling back the update or using a system restore point removes the conflicting patch and quickly restores system stability.

en.stem: A remote user needs software installed, requiring administrative privileges. What Windows tool allows the IT agent to take control of their screen and input credentials?
en.explanation: Remote support tools like Quick Assist, RDP, or TeamViewer allow help desk staff to view the screen and enter admin credentials securely.

en.stem: A user can log into their Windows PC but cannot access a department shared folder. Permissions are granted via AD groups. What is the most likely reason?
options: The user is not a member of the correct security group
The PC is in a workgroup
en.explanation: Access to resources in an AD environment is managed by Security Groups. Missing group membership prevents access.

en.stem: Group Policy Objects (GPOs) are applied in a specific order. According to the LSDOU model, which policy is applied LAST and has the highest precedence?
en.explanation: GPOs are processed in the order of Local, Site, Domain, and finally OU. The last applied policy wins in the event of a conflict.

en.stem: A technician is setting up a new PC and joins it to the company domain. What primary advantage does a Domain have over a Workgroup?
en.explanation: Domains use Active Directory for centralized identity management and policy enforcement, whereas Workgroups require local accounts on every PC.

en.stem: An admin deletes a user account by mistake. After recreating the exact same username, the user still cannot access their previous files. Why?
options: The new account has a different Security Identifier (SID)
The DNS cache needs to be flushed
The group policy needs to update
en.explanation: Active Directory tracks objects by a unique SID, not the username. Recreating an account creates a new SID.

en.stem: Which AD component acts as a container to organize users, groups, and computers, and allows for GPO delegation?
en.explanation: OUs are logical containers used to organize objects and apply Group Policies selectively.

en.stem: A user is locked out of their workstation. Which AD snap-in tool is primarily used by help desk to unlock accounts and reset passwords?
en.explanation: ADUC is the standard administrative tool used for daily identity management tasks like password resets and account unlocks.

en.stem: An administrator forces a Group Policy update on a client PC by running `gpupdate /force`. Which command verifies what policies are actually applied to the user and PC?
en.explanation: The `gpresult` tool displays the Resultant Set of Policy (RSoP) to show exactly which GPOs were applied or denied on a machine.

en.stem: Multiple users need to send and receive email from a generic address (e.g., support@company.com) without consuming an extra license. What Exchange Online feature should be used?
en.explanation: A Shared Mailbox allows multiple users to read and send email from a common address, and it does not require a separate M365 license.

en.stem: A technician is replacing a laptop keyboard. After reassembly, the display does not turn on but external monitors work. The MOST likely cause is...
options: The display ribbon cable was not reconnected properly.
The graphics card is burned out.
The laptop needs a BIOS update.
en.explanation: When working inside a laptop, a common mistake is failing to securely seat the fragile ribbon cables, such as the one for the built-in display.

en.stem: A user complains their mobile device screen frequently turns off when they hold it to their ear during a call. What component is responsible?
en.explanation: The proximity sensor detects when an object is close to the screen (like a face) and disables the display to save power and prevent accidental touches.

en.stem: A network technician is tasked with running cables through an air circulation space above a drop ceiling. What type of cable MUST be used?
en.explanation: Plenum-rated cables have a special fire-retardant jacket that produces less toxic smoke if burned, which is required by fire code for air-handling spaces.

en.stem: A small business needs to upgrade its wireless network to support the maximum number of devices and highest speeds utilizing both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands, plus a 6 GHz band. Which standard should they adopt?
en.explanation: Wi-Fi 6E extends the capabilities of Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) into the 6 GHz spectrum for less interference and higher speeds.

en.stem: A user is upgrading their motherboard and CPU. The new processor is an AMD Ryzen 7000 series. Which CPU socket type should the new motherboard have?
en.explanation: AMD Ryzen 7000 series processors use the AM5 LGA socket, marking a departure from the PGA AM4 socket.

en.stem: A gamer is building a new PC and wants the fastest possible boot times and game loading speeds. Which storage technology should they install on their motherboard?
en.explanation: NVMe M.2 SSDs use the PCIe bus, offering drastically higher read/write speeds compared to SATA SSDs or mechanical HDDs.

en.stem: A developer is testing an application on a Type 2 hypervisor. They are about to install a major software update and want to quickly revert if it fails. What feature should they use?
en.explanation: A snapshot captures the exact state of a virtual machine at a specific point in time, allowing for rapid rollback if something goes wrong.

en.stem: A startup is developing a web application. They want to rent servers, storage, and networking from a cloud provider but will install and manage their own OS and databases. Which service model is this?
en.explanation: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) provides the fundamental compute, network, and storage resources, leaving the OS and application management to the customer.

en.stem: A user reports that their laser printer is producing pages with ghosted images from previous prints. Which step of the laser printing process is MOST likely failing?
en.explanation: If the cleaning blade or erase lamps fail during the Cleaning step, residual toner or electrical charge remains on the drum, causing ghosting.

en.stem: A technician is troubleshooting a desktop that powers on, fans spin, but there is no display and it emits 3 short beeps. What does this indicate?
options: A POST error, likely related to RAM.
en.explanation: Beep codes are used during the Power-On Self-Test (POST) to indicate hardware failures before video is initialized. 3 short beeps often indicate memory errors.

en.stem: A company requires all corporate laptops to have their hard drives encrypted to protect data in case of theft. Which Windows feature provides full volume encryption?
en.explanation: BitLocker provides full drive encryption, whereas the Encrypting File System (EFS) is used for individual file and folder encryption.

en.stem: Which edition of Windows 10/11 is the minimum requirement to join an Active Directory domain?
en.explanation: Windows Home editions cannot join a Windows Server Active Directory domain; Pro or Enterprise is required.

en.stem: A technician suspects a device driver is causing system instability. Which tool allows them to view hardware conflicts, update drivers, or roll back to a previous driver version?
en.explanation: Device Manager is the centralized Microsoft Management Console snap-in used to manage hardware devices and their drivers.

en.stem: You run `sfc /scannow` and it reports `Windows Resource Protection found corrupt files but was unable to fix some of them`. What is the NEXT best step?
options: Run the DISM tool to repair the Windows image.
Boot into Safe Mode and run it again.
en.explanation: DISM (Deployment Image Servicing and Management) can repair the underlying Windows component store that SFC uses to fix corrupted files.

en.stem: A macOS user wants to restore a deleted file from two days ago. Which built-in utility should they use?
en.explanation: Time Machine is the native backup software for macOS, allowing users to restore individual files or the entire system from past backups.

en.stem: A Linux admin needs to assign read, write, and execute permissions to the owner of a script, but only read and execute to the group and others. Which command achieves this?
en.explanation: In octal permission notation, 7 (4+2+1) is rwx for the owner, and 5 (4+1) is r-x for group and others. Thus, 755 is correct.

en.stem: A user is trying to install an unverified application. A prompt appears asking for administrator credentials to allow the installation. What Windows security feature is triggering this prompt?
en.explanation: UAC helps prevent unauthorized changes to the operating system by prompting for elevation or credentials when administrative tasks are attempted.

en.stem: A system administrator wrote a script to automate the creation of Active Directory users and saved it with a .ps1 extension. Which language was used?
en.explanation: The .ps1 file extension is used for Windows PowerShell scripts, which are heavily used for administration in Windows environments.

en.stem: A user experiences a Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) with the stop code "IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL". What is the MOST common cause of this error?
en.explanation: This specific BSOD usually occurs when a kernel-mode driver attempts to access an improper memory address, pointing to driver issues.

en.stem: A technician has just finished replacing a faulty power supply in a user's PC and verified that it boots successfully into Windows. What is the FINAL step of the CompTIA troubleshooting methodology?
options: Establish a theory of probable cause.
en.explanation: The final step in the troubleshooting process is always to document the issue, what was done to fix it, and the final outcome for future reference.

en.stem: A laptop screen is entirely black, but shining a flashlight on it reveals a faint image of the Windows desktop. What component has failed?
en.explanation: A faint image indicates the LCD is rendering the image, but the backlight (or the inverter that powers it in older CCFL screens) has failed.

en.stem: A user needs to replace a failing internal storage drive in a thin-and-light ultrabook. Which form factor is MOST likely to fit?
en.explanation: Ultrabooks and thin laptops almost exclusively use M.2 SSDs due to their small size and weight compared to 2.5-inch drives.

en.stem: A technician is terminating a Cat 6 cable to connect a PC to a wall jack. Which connector should be used?
en.explanation: RJ-45 is the standard connector for twisted-pair Ethernet cables like Cat 5e, Cat 6, and Cat 6a.

en.stem: A company is running fiber optic cable between two buildings. The networking team needs a connector that uses a push-pull mechanism and is half the size of older connectors. Which should they use?
en.explanation: The Lucent Connector (LC) is a small form-factor fiber optic connector that uses a push-pull latching mechanism.

en.stem: An office is experiencing slow network speeds when transferring large video files over the local network. They are currently using Cat 5 cable. What should they upgrade to for 1 Gbps speeds?
en.explanation: Cat 5 is limited to 100 Mbps. Upgrading to Cat 5e or higher supports Gigabit Ethernet (1 Gbps) or faster.

en.stem: A user wants to upgrade their Windows 10 Home PC to a version that supports Microsoft Hyper-V and remote desktop hosting. Which edition should they purchase?
en.explanation: Windows 10 Pro includes features for power users and small businesses, such as Hyper-V, BitLocker, and Remote Desktop server.

en.stem: An administrator needs to enforce password complexity rules across all computers in a domain. Which Windows tool should they use?
en.explanation: Group Policy allows administrators to manage and enforce configurations, security policies, and software installations across a network.

en.stem: A technician is trying to format a stubborn USB drive that fails formatting in File Explorer. Which command-line tool allows for low-level partition management?
en.explanation: Diskpart is a powerful command-line utility used to manage disks, partitions, and volumes, often used when GUI tools fail.

en.stem: A user wants to view the error logs for an application that keeps crashing. Which Windows utility provides detailed logs of system and application events?
en.explanation: Event Viewer is the central tool for viewing logs of system events, security audits, and application errors.

en.stem: Which macOS utility is the equivalent of Windows File Explorer, used for browsing files and applications?
en.explanation: Finder is the default file manager and graphical user interface shell used on macOS.

en.stem: A receptionist receives a call from someone claiming to be the CEO, demanding a password reset immediately because they are about to start a critical board meeting. This BEST describes which attack?
en.explanation: Vishing (voice phishing) uses a telephone call to socially engineer a victim. The urgency and authority are classic elements of this attack.

en.stem: An employee receives an SMS on their corporate phone stating their multi-factor authentication app needs a critical update, including a link to download an APK. What type of attack is occurring?
en.explanation: Smishing uses SMS text messages to deliver malicious links or social engineering lures. Vishing uses voice, while pretexting is the broader creation of a fabricated scenario.

en.stem: A contractor holding a large box of networking equipment waits by the secure datacenter door until an authorized employee scans their badge and opens it, then follows them inside. This is known as...
en.explanation: Tailgating is following an authorized user into a restricted area without consent or proper authentication. Piggybacking implies the authorized user consented.

en.stem: The CFO of a logistics company receives a highly customized email claiming a wire transfer for a known vendor has failed. The email contains a link to a fake banking portal. This attack is an example of...
en.explanation: Whaling is a highly targeted phishing attack aimed at senior executives (C-level) who have high-level access or financial authority.

en.stem: An attacker leaves several USB drives labeled "Q3 Layoffs & Bonuses" in the company parking lot, hoping curious employees will plug them into corporate workstations. This technique is called...
en.explanation: Baiting relies on curiosity or greed, offering something enticing (like a USB drive with an interesting label) to trick the victim into compromising their system.

en.stem: A threat actor creates a fake LinkedIn profile claiming to be an IT recruiter. They spend weeks chatting with a systems administrator before asking them to run a "skills assessment" executable. This scenario heavily utilizes...
en.explanation: Pretexting involves creating a believable fabricated scenario (a pretext) to build trust over time before exploiting the victim.

en.stem: During a penetration test, an assessor sits in the break room and watches an employee type their complex password into a laptop. The assessor then uses these credentials later. What occurred?
en.explanation: Shoulder surfing involves visually observing a user entering sensitive information, such as a password or PIN.

en.stem: A hospital's patient records system suddenly displays a red screen demanding payment in Bitcoin within 48 hours to decrypt the database. What type of malware has infected the system?
en.explanation: Ransomware encrypts files or locks systems and demands payment for the decryption key or restoration of access.

en.stem: A security analyst discovers that a compromised workstation has software installed that allows an attacker to remotely open the CD-ROM tray, turn on the webcam, and browse the filesystem without user knowledge. This is a...
en.explanation: A Remote Access Trojan (RAT) provides an attacker with administrative control over a target system over a network connection.

en.stem: After a suspected breach, administrators notice that standard operating system commands like 'ls' and 'ps' are not showing a malicious process that is consuming CPU resources. The malware has likely installed a...
en.explanation: Rootkits modify the core operating system (often hooking kernel functions) to hide their presence, processes, files, and network connections from standard tools.

en.stem: An employee unknowingly downloads a malicious browser extension that records every keystroke made on banking websites and sends the text to an external server. This malware is a...
en.explanation: A keylogger records user keystrokes, often to steal credentials, credit card numbers, or other sensitive information.

en.stem: Users complain that their web browsers are constantly redirecting to search engines they did not set, and pop-up ads appear even when the browser is closed. The systems are likely infected with...
en.explanation: Spyware secretly monitors user behavior and gathers information, often redirecting browsers, changing settings, and displaying unwanted advertisements (often overlapping with adware).

en.stem: A piece of malware exploits a vulnerability in SMBv1 to spread rapidly across a corporate network without any user interaction, infecting hundreds of machines in minutes. This behavior characterizes a...
en.explanation: Worms are self-replicating malware that spread across networks automatically without requiring a host file or user interaction.

en.stem: An end-user downloads what appears to be a legitimate free PDF editor from a third-party site. Once installed, it edits PDFs but also silently installs a backdoor. This is an example of a...
en.explanation: A Trojan horse disguises itself as legitimate or desirable software to trick users into installing it, while hiding malicious functionality.

en.stem: An endpoint detection system flags unusual PowerShell activity. Investigation reveals a malicious script running entirely in RAM, heavily obfuscated, leaving no executable footprint on the hard drive. This is...
en.explanation: Fileless malware operates in memory (RAM) and abuses native legitimate tools (like PowerShell or WMI) rather than dropping an executable file on the disk.

en.stem: A technician is running a new 50A branch circuit to a range. They pull 8 AWG THHN copper wire through an attic where the ambient temperature reaches 120°F. During inspection, the installation fails. Why?
options: The wire gauge is too small after applying ambient temperature derating factors
A 50A circuit requires a minimum of 6 AWG regardless of temperature
THHN is not permitted in residential attics
The breaker must be upgraded to 60A to match the 8 AWG capacity
en.explanation: When ambient temperatures exceed 86°F (30°C), NEC requires ampacity derating. 8 AWG THHN at 50A will fall below the required capacity when derated for 120°F (49°C).

en.stem: While remodeling a residential bathroom, an apprentice wires a new 20A receptacle directly to the vanity light switch circuit without GFCI protection. What specific code violation has occurred?
options: Bathroom receptacles must have GFCI protection and be on a dedicated 20A circuit
The receptacle must be on a 15A circuit
Lights and receptacles must share a 15A AFCI circuit
The receptacle needs AFCI, not GFCI protection
en.explanation: NEC requires bathroom receptacles to be GFCI protected and supplied by a dedicated 20A branch circuit that does not serve other areas.

en.stem: A homeowner complains that a newly installed bedroom outlet trips the breaker whenever a lamp is turned on. The panel has a dual-function AFCI/GFCI breaker. What is the most likely cause?
options: A shared neutral or ground fault is triggering the AFCI/GFCI protection
The lamp is drawing more than 20 amps
The breaker is sized too small for a bedroom
The receptacle is installed upside down
en.explanation: Dual-function breakers are sensitive to arc faults and ground faults. A shared neutral or slight ground leakage will cause them to trip immediately upon load.

en.stem: During an inspection of a commercial kitchen, you notice the 125V, 15A receptacles near the sinks lack GFCI protection. The manager claims they are exempt because they are dedicated for refrigerators. How should you respond?
options: All 15A and 20A, 125V receptacles in a commercial kitchen require GFCI protection, regardless of their intended use
The manager is correct; dedicated appliance receptacles are exempt
Only receptacles within 6 feet of the sink need GFCI
GFCI is only required for 250V receptacles in kitchens
en.explanation: NEC 210.8(B) mandates that all 15A and 20A, 125V receptacles in commercial kitchens must be GFCI protected. There are no exemptions for dedicated equipment.

en.stem: An electrician installs a 100A subpanel in a detached garage using a 3-wire feeder (two hots, one neutral) and bonds the neutral to the ground bus at the subpanel. What is the primary safety risk here?
options: Objectionable current will flow on the neutral and metal enclosures back to the main panel
The subpanel will not have 240V available
The breakers in the subpanel will trip instantly
The ground rod at the garage will overheat
en.explanation: NEC requires a 4-wire feeder (separated neutral and ground) to detached buildings to prevent the neutral current from traveling on the equipment grounding path.

en.stem: A maintenance tech uses a megohmmeter to test a 480V 3-phase pump motor. The reading from phase A to ground is 0.5 MΩ. What should the tech conclude?
options: The motor insulation is severely degraded and the motor should be removed from service
The motor is in perfect condition and ready to run
The reading is acceptable if the motor is warm
The tech should use a multimeter instead of a megohmmeter
en.explanation: For a 480V motor, insulation resistance should generally be >1 MΩ. A 0.5 MΩ reading indicates significant insulation breakdown or moisture ingress.

en.stem: You place a clamp-on ammeter around an extension cord powering a running 12A space heater, but the meter reads 0.00A. What is the reason for this reading?
options: The clamp is around both the hot and neutral wires, canceling out the magnetic fields
The heater is operating at 100% efficiency
The ammeter is set to DC instead of AC
en.explanation: A clamp meter must be placed around a single conductor (the hot or the neutral). If placed around the entire cable, the opposing currents cancel the magnetic field, resulting in a zero reading.

en.stem: A technician measures voltage at a standard 120V receptacle and gets 120V between hot and neutral, but 0V between neutral and ground, and 60V between hot and ground. What is the most likely fault?
options: The equipment grounding conductor is open or floating
The hot and neutral wires are reversed
There is a direct short between hot and neutral
en.explanation: If the ground is floating (open), capacitive coupling can cause the hot-to-ground voltage to read arbitrarily (often around half voltage, like 60V) with a high-impedance digital multimeter.

en.stem: When checking a 3-phase panel, you read 120V from Phase A to Neutral, 120V from Phase B to Neutral, and 208V from Phase C to Neutral. What type of electrical system are you testing?
en.explanation: In a high-leg (or wild-leg) delta system, the center tap of one transformer is grounded, making the voltage from the high leg (typically Phase C) to neutral exactly √3 * 120V = 208V.

en.stem: An industrial oven keeps tripping its breaker intermittently. A tech checks the amp draw and finds it steady at 38A on a 40A breaker. Why is the breaker tripping?
options: The continuous load exceeds 80% of the breaker rating
The breaker is defective and must be replaced
The oven has a severe ground fault
The voltage is fluctuating too much
en.explanation: Standard breakers are rated to carry 80% of their rating continuously. 80% of 40A is 32A. A 38A continuous load will cause the thermal element to trip eventually.

en.stem: You are replacing a 10 HP, 460V, 3-phase motor. The nameplate lists the Full Load Amps (FLA) as 14.0A and the Service Factor as 1.15. What is the maximum setting for the overload relays according to general NEC rules?
en.explanation: For motors with a Service Factor of 1.15 or greater, the NEC allows the overload device to be sized up to 125% of the nameplate FLA (14.0 * 1.25 = 17.5A).

en.stem: A large induction motor utilizes a star-delta starter to reduce inrush current. During the start sequence, the motor starts in star but trips the main breaker the exact moment it transitions to delta. What is the most likely cause?
options: The phase sequencing in the delta contactor is reversed, causing a dead short or massive torque spike
The timer is set too long, overheating the star contactor
The motor requires a soft starter instead of star-delta
The thermal overloads are set too low
en.explanation: If the wiring on the delta contactor is not phased correctly matching the motor rotation, the transition creates a massive phase-to-phase short or instant torque reversal, tripping the breaker immediately.

en.stem: An operator reports that a 3-phase conveyor motor is "humming loudly and getting extremely hot" but not turning. Voltage measurements at the motor peckerhead show 480V between L1-L2, 0V between L2-L3, and 0V between L1-L3. What is happening?
options: The motor is single-phasing due to a blown fuse or broken wire on L3
The motor bearings have seized completely
The stator windings are shorted to ground
The VFD frequency is set to zero
en.explanation: With 0V across two phase pairs, one of the incoming lines (L3) is dead. The motor is experiencing a single-phasing condition, causing high current, heat, and humming without rotation.

en.stem: When wiring a dual-voltage (230/460V) 9-lead 3-phase motor for high voltage (460V), how should the windings be connected?
en.explanation: For a dual-voltage motor, the windings are connected in series for the high-voltage application so that each winding receives its rated voltage.

en.stem: A technician is sizing the branch circuit conductors for a single 25 HP, 460V, 3-phase motor with a table FLC of 34A. What is the minimum ampacity required for these conductors?
en.explanation: NEC requires branch circuit conductors for a single continuous duty motor to be sized at 125% of the motor full-load current rating (FLC). 34A * 1.25 = 42.5A.

en.stem: While analyzing an OTDR trace of a newly installed 5km single-mode link, you see a sharp spike upwards followed by a drop in the trace level. What physical event does this signature represent?
options: A reflective event with loss, such as a mechanical splice or connector
A non-reflective event, such as a perfect fusion splice
A ghost reflection from the launch cable
en.explanation: A sharp spike indicates reflectance (Fresnel reflection), and the subsequent drop indicates insertion loss. This is the classic signature of a mated connector pair or mechanical splice.

en.stem: An OTDR trace shows an event at 4km that appears to be a "gainer" (the trace goes up, showing negative loss). What is the actual physical cause of a gainer in an OTDR trace?
options: Splicing two fibers with different backscatter coefficients (e.g., mismatch in core sizes or MFD)
The splicing machine added power to the optical signal
The fiber was repaired with an optical amplifier
The OTDR laser pulse is reflecting off a mirror-like finish
en.explanation: A gainer is an optical illusion on an OTDR caused by splicing a fiber with a lower backscatter coefficient to one with a higher coefficient. More light scatters back, making it look like a gain in power.

en.stem: You are shooting an OTDR trace on a short 100m patch cord but cannot see the connector at the far end clearly due to the initial pulse width. What setting should you adjust?
options: Decrease the pulse width to improve spatial resolution
Increase the pulse width to push more power into the fiber
Increase the averaging time to 3 minutes
en.explanation: A shorter pulse width provides better spatial resolution, allowing the OTDR to distinguish closely spaced events, which is essential for short links.

en.stem: You perform a Tier 1 certification (OLTS) on a multi-mode fiber link. The measured loss is 2.5 dB, but the calculated loss budget is 1.8 dB. What is the immediate result?
options: The link fails certification and requires troubleshooting or re-termination
The link passes because 2.5 dB is less than 3.0 dB
The link conditionally passes but requires an OTDR trace
The link passes because multi-mode allows up to 5 dB of loss
en.explanation: If the measured insertion loss exceeds the calculated loss budget for that specific link (based on length, splices, and connectors), the link fails certification.

en.stem: When measuring Optical Return Loss (ORL) on a single-mode video link, the meter reads 20 dB. The specification requires >45 dB. What does the 20 dB reading indicate?
options: There is a highly reflective connector or poor splice causing massive reflection back to the source
The link has an excellent return loss and passes easily
The fiber is broken perfectly clean in the middle of the run
en.explanation: ORL is measured in positive dB representing the amount of attenuation the reflected signal experiences. A low number (20 dB) means very little attenuation of the reflection, meaning a LOT of light is bouncing back. It needs to be >45 dB.

en.stem: A technician scopes an SC/UPC connector and sees a large dark smudge directly over the core of the fiber. What is the correct next step?
options: Clean the endface using a dry-cleaning cassette or lint-free wipe with solvent, then re-inspect
Plug it in anyway; the laser will burn the dirt off
Cut off the connector and splice on a new pigtail immediately
en.explanation: Contamination should always be cleaned using proper fiber cleaning methods (dry or wet-to-dry) and re-inspected before mating to prevent permanent damage.

en.stem: Under a fiber microscope, you observe permanent pitting and scratches crossing the 9-micron core of a single-mode LC connector, even after multiple wet/dry cleanings. What is the impact on performance?
options: It will cause high insertion loss and poor reflectance (low ORL)
It will only affect transmission if using 1550nm
It will cause the fiber to melt when used with high power lasers
It has no effect as long as the cladding is intact
en.explanation: Scratches and pitting across the core permanently degrade the optical signal by scattering light, increasing insertion loss and causing high back-reflection.

en.stem: During a campus backbone installation, a contractor pulls a 24-strand outdoor loose-tube cable around a 90-degree conduit bend. The conduit diameter is 2 inches, and the cable diameter is 0.5 inches. The contractor bends the cable over a 4-inch radius. Why is this a problem?
options: The bend radius is too tight; under tension, the minimum bend radius is typically 20x the cable diameter (10 inches)
The bend radius must be exactly 15 inches for all cables
The conduit is too small for a 0.5-inch cable
Outdoor cable cannot be run in conduit
en.explanation: Fiber cables under pulling tension generally require a bend radius of at least 20 times the cable diameter (0.5 * 20 = 10 inches). Bending it at 4 inches risks breaking the glass or inducing macrobends.

en.stem: You are terminating a 12-strand distribution cable. According to the standard TIA-598 color code, what is the color of fiber #6?
en.explanation: The TIA-598 color code is: 1-Blue, 2-Orange, 3-Green, 4-Brown, 5-Slate, 6-White, 7-Red, 8-Black, 9-Yellow, 10-Violet, 11-Rose, 12-Aqua.

en.stem: A crew is pulling a heavy armored OSP cable using a tugger. They exceed the maximum rated pulling tension of 600 lbs for a few seconds. Later, tests show high attenuation across all fibers. What physically happened inside the cable?
options: The fiber glass was stretched beyond its yield point, causing microscopic fractures and elevated attenuation
The Kevlar aramid yarn melted from the friction
The armor shield magnetized, disrupting the optical signal
The cladding separated from the core
en.explanation: Exceeding the tensile load limit stretches the glass itself, causing micro-cracking and permanent attenuation increases, even if the cable jacket looks fine.

en.stem: A data center needs to upgrade a 100-meter server-to-switch link to 40GBASE-SR4. What type of fiber and wavelength should they select for the most cost-effective solution?
en.explanation: For short data center runs (up to 150m) at 40Gbps or 100Gbps, OM4 multimode fiber using VCSEL lasers at 850nm is the standard, cost-effective choice (SR4).

en.stem: A telecom provider is troubleshooting a 60km long-haul single-mode link. The link passes perfectly at 1310nm but shows 8 dB of excess loss at 1550nm. What is the most likely physical cause?
options: There is a severe macrobend somewhere in the cable run
The fiber is contaminated with water (water peak attenuation)
1310nm is inherently better at traveling long distances than 1550nm
en.explanation: Macrobends (sharp physical bends in the fiber) cause significantly higher loss at longer wavelengths like 1550nm because the light mode field diameter is larger and more easily escapes the core when bent.

en.stem: A technician spliced two pigtails in a splice tray. The link passes the initial OTDR test. Two days later, the link drops. When the tech opens the tray, the link suddenly comes back up. What is the likely issue?
options: The fiber was twisted or pinched by the splice tray lid, creating a macrobend under pressure
The fusion splice was "cold" and needed exposure to air to heal
Light from the room illuminated the fiber and restored the signal
The pigtail jacket absorbed moisture from the air
en.explanation: Improper routing in a splice tray can cause the lid to pinch a fiber, inducing a severe macrobend or mechanical stress. Opening the tray relieves the pressure.

en.stem: You are designing a DWDM network using the ITU-T G.694.1 grid. The system uses a 100 GHz channel spacing. Approximately how much wavelength separation exists between adjacent channels?
en.explanation: In Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM), a 100 GHz frequency spacing corresponds to approximately 0.8 nm of wavelength spacing in the 1550nm (C-band) region.

en.stem: A technician accidentally patches a CWDM transceiver module transmitting at 1470nm into a DWDM multiplexer designed for the C-band. What will happen?
options: The DWDM multiplexer will block the signal entirely
The signal will pass through normally
The multiplexer will shift the wavelength to 1550nm automatically
The CWDM laser will burn out the DWDM filters
en.explanation: DWDM multiplexers have very narrow passbands (e.g., in the 1530-1565nm range). A 1470nm CWDM signal will simply be filtered out (blocked) and won't pass through.

en.stem: A maintenance team replaces the air filters on HVAC rooftop units every three months, regardless of their condition. What type of maintenance strategy is this?
en.explanation: Preventive maintenance is performed on a calendar or run-time schedule to prevent failures before they occur, regardless of current condition.

en.stem: A facility uses ultrasonic sensors to monitor the high-frequency acoustic emissions of roller bearings on a critical conveyor. When the acoustic signature crosses a threshold, a work order is generated. What strategy is this?
en.explanation: Predictive maintenance monitors actual asset conditions (vibration, acoustics, temp) to predict when failure will occur and trigger maintenance exactly when needed.

en.stem: A technician repairing a failed boiler feed pump decides to analyze why the seal failed. They discover the baseplate is vibrating due to improper grouting, so they regrout the baseplate to prevent future seal failures. What strategy does this represent?
en.explanation: Proactive maintenance goes beyond fixing the immediate breakdown (reactive) and addresses the root cause of the failure to eliminate the defect entirely.

en.stem: A technician is troubleshooting a PLC ladder logic program. A physical emergency stop button is wired normally closed (NC) in the field. In the ladder logic, what instruction should be used to allow the machine to run when the E-stop is NOT pressed?
options: Examine If Closed (XIC / Normally Open contact)
Examine If Open (XIO / Normally Closed contact)
en.explanation: Since the physical button is NC, it constantly supplies 24V to the input card. An XIC instruction looks for this "True" state to allow the logic to flow and the machine to run.

en.stem: A PLC controls a pneumatic cylinder. The sequence stops mid-cycle. The technician forces the output bit ON in the PLC software, and the cylinder moves. What does this confirm?
options: The field wiring, output card, and solenoid valve are functioning, so the issue is in the logic conditions (inputs)
The PLC output card has failed completely
The solenoid valve is mechanically stuck
en.explanation: By forcing the output and observing field movement, the tech proves the hardware path from the PLC to the actuator is intact. The logic is failing to turn the bit on naturally.

en.stem: A pressure transmitter operates on a standard 4-20mA loop. What is the primary advantage of using a "live zero" (4mA) instead of 0-20mA?
options: It allows the control system to detect a broken wire (0mA) as a fault, distinguishing it from a zero reading
It saves power by drawing less current
It allows the loop to carry voice communications
It prevents the transmitter from freezing in cold weather
en.explanation: With 4-20mA, 4mA represents 0% of the scale. If the wire breaks, current drops to 0mA, instantly alerting the system to a loop failure (dead zero).

en.stem: A level transmitter is scaled from 0 to 100 inches. The loop current is currently measuring 12mA. What is the actual water level in the tank?
en.explanation: The total span is 16mA (from 4 to 20). 12mA is exactly halfway between 4mA and 20mA (8mA span). Therefore, the process variable is at 50% of 100 inches, which is 50 inches.

en.stem: A 4-20mA loop is wired in series through a transmitter, a PLC input card (250 ohm resistor), and a chart recorder (250 ohm resistor). The power supply is 24VDC. The transmitter requires a minimum of 12VDC to operate. Will this loop function at 20mA?
options: Yes. The voltage drop across the resistors is 10V (500 ohms * 0.02A), leaving 14V for the transmitter
No. The resistance is too high and will choke the current to 10mA
No. The transmitter will receive 24V and burn out
Yes, but the chart recorder will not read accurately
en.explanation: Total resistance = 500 ohms. At 20mA (0.02A), V_drop = I*R = 0.02 * 500 = 10V. 24V - 10V = 14V remaining at the transmitter. Since 14V > 12V minimum, the loop functions perfectly.

en.stem: A technician calibrates a pH probe. They record the readings before making any adjustments, then calibrate the device, and record the readings again. What is this documentation standard called?
en.explanation: Recording "As-Found" data proves how accurate the device was during operation (critical for quality auditing), while "As-Left" proves it was correct when the tech finished.

en.stem: A temperature transmitter is calibrated for 0°C to 200°C. During a 5-point calibration, the tech notes that the output is perfectly accurate going up the scale, but reads consistently 2 degrees high when coming down the scale. What physical phenomenon is the instrument exhibiting?
en.explanation: Hysteresis is the maximum difference in output for the same input value when approached from opposite directions (increasing vs decreasing).

en.stem: A vibration analyst reviews an FFT spectrum on a large centrifugal fan running at 1800 RPM (30 Hz). There is a massive spike exactly at 1X running speed (30 Hz). What is the most likely mechanical fault?
options: Mass unbalance of the fan rotor
en.explanation: A high vibration amplitude exactly at 1X turning speed is the classic signature of mass unbalance. The heavy spot causes one vibration peak per revolution.

en.stem: An induction motor driving a pump via a flexible coupling shows high vibration at 1X and 2X turning speed, accompanied by a 180-degree phase shift across the coupling. What is the definitive diagnosis?
options: Angular misalignment between the motor and the pump
A bent shaft on the pump
en.explanation: Misalignment typically shows up as high 1X and 2X radial/axial vibration. A 180-degree phase shift across the coupling confirms that the shafts are out of alignment, fighting each other.

en.stem: A maintenance electrician scans a 3-phase motor starter with an infrared camera. Phase A is 45°C, Phase B is 46°C, and Phase C is 95°C. What is the most likely cause of this discrepancy?
options: A loose connection on Phase C causing high resistance heating
Phase C is carrying normal load current
The motor has a blown Phase A fuse
The infrared camera needs to be recalibrated
en.explanation: A single hot phase in a 3-phase connection is almost always caused by high resistance at a loose, corroded, or failing termination.

en.stem: When conducting an outdoor thermography inspection of a substation on a bright sunny day, the technician notes that all the ceramic insulators on the east side appear extremely hot. What must the technician consider?
options: Solar loading (sunlight) is heating the components, masking or mimicking electrical faults
Ceramic inherently generates heat on the east side due to magnetic fields
The east side of a substation always carries more current
The emissivity of ceramic changes depending on the time of day
en.explanation: Solar loading is a major factor in outdoor thermography. Sun shining on equipment heats it up, which can create false hotspots or hide true electrical faults.

en.stem: A process engineer wants to change the alarm setpoint of a high-pressure reactor from 500 psi to 550 psi to prevent nuisance trips. The vessel is rated for 600 psi. What formal process MUST be followed before the technician makes the change in the PLC?
en.explanation: Any modification to process safety parameters, setpoints, or equipment design requires a formal Management of Change (MOC) to evaluate risks and update documentation before implementation.

en.stem: A junior admin is looking at a packet capture and notices MAC addresses are being used to forward frames. Which OSI layer is responsible for this activity?
en.explanation: Objective 1.1: The Data Link layer (Layer 2) uses MAC addresses for local frame delivery. Network uses IP, Physical uses bits, Transport uses ports.

en.stem: While investigating a slow application, you observe TCP window size zero messages in Wireshark. At what layer of the OSI model does this flow control issue reside?
en.explanation: Objective 1.1: The Transport layer (Layer 4) handles TCP flow control, including windowing. Application is Layer 7, Session Layer 5, Network Layer 3.

en.stem: Users report that their web browsers are failing to negotiate TLS encryption with a newly deployed internal server. Which OSI layer is failing to establish this secure connection?
en.explanation: Objective 1.1: The Presentation layer (Layer 6) handles encryption/decryption like TLS. Application handles HTTP, Session handles teardown, Transport handles TCP.

en.stem: An engineer connects a spectrum analyzer to a coax cable to check for electromagnetic interference. What OSI layer is being analyzed?
en.explanation: Objective 1.1: The Physical layer (Layer 1) deals with signaling, cables, and interference. Data Link is frames, Network is packets.

en.stem: A routing loop has caused TTL values to expire, dropping IP packets. In which OSI layer does the TTL field exist?
en.explanation: Objective 1.1: The Network layer (Layer 3) encapsulates IP packets which contain the TTL field. Transport is ports, Data Link is MACs.

en.stem: During a network outage, a technician finds that a fiber optic cable was accidentally severed. Which layer of the OSI model is directly impacted by this physical break?
